import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")


# Clean the Comment column - remove surrounding quotes and handle unicode escapes
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    # Remove surrounding quotes
    text = str(text)
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        text = text[1:-1]
    # Decode unicode escapes
    text = text.encode("utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text


train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["Comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Create TF-IDF features with both word and character n-grams
# Word n-grams (unigrams and bigrams)
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_features=10000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Character n-grams (3-5 grams)
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=10000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Fit on training data
word_features_train = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["Comment"])
char_features_train = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["Comment"])

# Combine features
from scipy.sparse import hstack

X_train_combined = hstack([word_features_train, char_features_train])
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values

# Split into train and validation (80/20 stratified)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_combined, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train Linear SVM on training split
model = LinearSVC(C=1.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=42)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Get probability predictions for validation set
val_proba = model.decision_function(X_val)
# Convert to probabilities using sigmoid
val_proba = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-val_proba))

# Calculate AUC-ROC on validation set
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_proba)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Train final model on all training data
model_final = LinearSVC(C=1.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=42)
model_final.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Transform test data
word_features_test = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment"])
char_features_test = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment"])
X_test_combined = hstack([word_features_test, char_features_test])

# Predict on test set
test_proba = model_final.decision_function(X_test_combined)
test_proba = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-test_proba))

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Insult": test_proba, "Comment": test_df["Comment"], "Date": test_df["Date"]}
)

# Save to submission directory
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Test predictions shape: {test_proba.shape}")
print(f"Sample predictions: {test_proba[:5]}")
